items.q: Yeah, well Bob Thomas and Captain Handy used to work with him and they'd come back. Yeah, I don't know.

ctx.x: Clabin Williams. Clabin Williams was the one I want to talk about. They was there sometimes. What about Bud Scott? Well, when Bud Scott was there I wouldn't know about him. But you knew him. You knew him? Yeah, I knew him. From Natchez, I'm talking about that. Yeah, yeah, you talk about that Bud Scott who was up in Natchez, Mississippi and they got in a fire and they all burned up and all that. Yeah, I knew him. What about Toots Johnson? Would he ever come to
know him? I don't know. He's from Baton Rouge. Yeah, I don't know him. Yeah, well Bob Thomas and Captain
